additional_info.subject: ID0468186-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002734] Charger Unavailable and Disconnected. CRM:03056000808
additional_info.body:
Dear Maria,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
We checked the charger and the OCPP connection was indeed offline. We performed a soft reboot to the charger, and now the connection seems stable.
We also see that the outlets are activated again, after doing the reboot. The status that was showing was a bug, but this is fixed now.
The charger should work in a good state again.
Please provide me with feedback, so i can close the ticket.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
